package.name: nros_runner_native
package.description:
The `native` runner (RFC-0119 D8). Runs a host image as a process: Linux and POSIX native builds, threadx-linux, freertos-posix, and Zephyr native_sim's zephyr.exe (with a per-process --seed).
A runner package of the same shape as a user's: the announcement below is what the provider scan reads, `nros-runner.toml` is read only when this provider is the one selected, and the executable speaks RFC-0119 D6.
